The AAR POM labels the package LGPL2.1. This does not establish that every bundled native module is LGPL-compatible. Native modules, exact corresponding source, contrib licenses and Android toolchain notices remain under audit in ThirdParty/libvlc. The included license texts are not a complete redistribution notice bundle. Do not publish this APK until the root third-party audit gate clears.
